reviews.summary: The four-part table and a 'make it yours' line under every sample beat the copy-paste lists, but there was no goodnight paragraph, the one moment every top result covers.

The love-letter guide has five steps, not four parts; the FAQ's 80-120 words contradicted the samples (66-81); the link sentence added to the good-morning post misdescribed this post; ES 'chupito', 'estar a dos semanas', 'pillarse haciendo', 'raro' for rare, 'evita la mitad de su jornada' and 'algo verdad'.
The only result with a method, but 'paragraphs to make her cry' is the biggest variant of the search and every top result gives it a section.

applied: New section 'A long paragraph to make her cry (the good kind)' with a sample and how to make it yours (EN and ES).
New section 'A paragraph to send her at night', linking the good-morning post (EN and ES).
Love-letter link: 'builds a longer letter the same way, in five steps' (ES matches).
FAQ length: 'around 60 to 90 words' / 'entre 60 y 90 palabras'; every sample now falls in that range.
Good-morning post's link sentence names this post's moments and introduces its own quotes ('Two for the morning:').
ES: 'doble de café', 'faltan dos semanas para verte', 'te has sorprendido haciendo', 'llega pocas veces', 'Evita mandarlo en plena jornada… de madrugada… de vez en cuando', 'Algo cierto ahora'.

Polish taken: US/UK-neutral 'taken care of… what we watch', 'right now', one varied 'Make it yours' opener, 'when she isn't rushing'; ES 'que pase después', 'dice más', 'Estoy orgulloso de ser', 'Elige bien el momento', 'por el chat', parallel FAQ list.
rejected: Polish not taken: 'long paragraphs… make her cry' in the description (over 160 characters), and linking a sorry-message post that doesn't exist yet.

reviews.summary: Top results give dozens of interchangeable compliment paragraphs; this gives a reusable shape, seven specific paragraphs for the moments people write them, the detail to swap in each and when to send it.
All round-one fixes made correctly and every sample counted inside 60 to 90 words; one Spanish calque in the new 'make her cry' sample: 'hiciste que fuera sobre ti'.

Page one is near-duplicate spam and lists of interchangeable compliments; this gives a four-part method with a worked table, seven paragraphs for the situations people search and the detail to change in each.

applied: ES: 'ni una sola vez te pusiste tú en el centro'.

Polish taken: ES 'te acordaras de cómo tomo el té', 'mantener los ojos abiertos', 'cuando no vaya con prisa'; the night sample no longer says it can wait until morning when the advice is to send it before she sleeps (EN and ES); 'hard stretch' / 'temporada difícil'.
rejected: Polish not taken: a birthday section, 'long' and 'make her cry' in the title or description, setting up the tea earlier, and varying the 'Make it yours' openers again.

reviews.summary: Top results hand you dozens of interchangeable compliment paragraphs; this gives a four-part shape with a worked example, seven paragraphs built on concrete moments and a note under each saying exactly which detail to swap.

The only page for this search that teaches a four-part shape and gives seven paragraphs for specific moments, each 60 to 90 words with the one detail to change, checked against the product and mirrored in natural Spain Spanish.

Page one is lists of 100 to 140 interchangeable messages and scraped duplicates; this is the one page that teaches the shape of a good paragraph, gives seven sincere samples for the moments people search and shows which detail to change.

rejected: Final-round polish recorded, not applied (RUBRIC step 4): a birthday section, 'long' in the title, linking a future sorry-message post, the Text Thread note's 'never send by text', 'eyes' twice, 'café' three times, setting up the tea, 'saying sorry'.
